text:
jamal: FYI hitting a nasty interaction in the Go sample app during onboarding: paginator prefetch + short-lived STS -> everyone refreshes -> gateway 429s.

jamal: Repro is deterministic in our staging: start 12 goroutines each iterating the Paginator with Prefetch=3, set creds TTL=6s, wait ~1m, see repeated 429 spikes.

sophie: Oof. Can you paste the sample usage?

jamal: Sure:```go
p := redwood.NewPaginator("/v1/embeds", redwood.PageSize(100), redwood.Prefetch(3))
for p.Next() {
  page := p.Page()
  go func(pg []Item){
    _, _ = client.Embed(ctx, pg)
  }(page)
}
```

jamal: The problem is the auth refresh path uses a naive check `if token.Expired() { refresh() }` without singleflight, so each goroutine tries to refresh roughly at the same time.

li: We have singleflight in the JS SDK but Go implementation never added it due to earlier refactor.

jamal: Also the Paginator keeps prefetching while upstream returns 401s, so queue depth increases then all workers retry simultaneously.

sophie: Two-kludge immediate mitigations: (A) reduce Prefetch to 0 or 1 in sample app; (B) add token refresh dedupe using golang.org/x/sync/singleflight in auth transport.

li: I can prototype a small middleware that uses singleflight.Do("refresh", func(){...}) and ensure other requests wait for the result. That should collapse the stampede.

jamal: Patch idea for Paginator: pause prefetch when we see >=2 consecutive 401s for a tenant for X seconds, exponential backoff on subsequent pages. Simple circuit-breaker style.

sophie: Agree. We should also document "short-lived creds note" on our quickstart: when using STS reduce prefetch or enable SDK refresh dedupe.

li: I'll open two PRs: one for auth singleflight in go-sdk, another for pause-on-auth-failure in paginator.

build-bot: CI queued for branch go/auth-singleflight 1 pipeline started.

metrics-bot: staging alert: `2026-03-02T12:04:07Z gateway 429 rate_limit tenant=acct-foo concurrent=14 path=/v1/embeds spike=+120%`

jamal: Thanks. Can someone add a small test to go-sdk CI that simulates token rotation and ensures only one refresh occurs per rotation window? Catches regressions.

li: Yup will add test that uses fake token provider and counts refresh calls.

sophie: And I'll update sampleapp readme and onboarding checklist. Mention to ops that if customers use very short STS TTLs (<30s) they should expect to tune client prefetch.

jamal: Nice work. Marking follow-up to verify post-PR and after a couple staging runs.

li: PRs: github.com/redwood/go-sdk/pull/472 and github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/88 (wip).

sophie: 44d closing loop once merge is deployed.
